block_reason: Port 8000 is a Decisions-API server, not a text generator. It exposes only GET /, /health, /v1/models and POST /v1/systemone. v1/systemone takes {questions:{name:{type:noul|choice|score,...}}} and returns probabilities (noul/score/legend/confidence) with usage.output_tokens=1. /v1/models describes OneJev-9B.IQ4_XS as 'Qev decision model (qwen3_5)'. It therefore cannot emit reasoning or content prose, which train.jsonl requires.
